prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, blunt bob golden blonde hair — wearing a glossy black latex micro wrap-tie top, a narrow opaque strip crossing over both breasts and tied in a knot at the back, and a minimal low-rise glossy black latex bottom of one tiny opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque pieces fully covering her, her stomach bare. Her left leg wears a pale pink satin ribbon wound in an even spiral around her left leg from the ankle up to just below the knee, crossing over the front of the shin and tied in a neat bow at the outer side of the knee, resting snug on the skin and running down into her heel. Her right leg is bare from the hip to the toes. She wears an enormous floppy straw beach hat with an extremely wide brim reaching out past her shoulders, a white silk band tied in a bow around the crown, worn over her hair. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.

Tattoo: one irezumi tattoo on her bare skin: a coiling emerald-green dragon with gold claws and white clouds, with bold black outlines, placed on her entire right leg from the thigh to the ankle only, with the rest of her skin left bare. The tattoo is permanent ink in the skin, not paint on it.
Piercing: a large gold navel hoop with a big white pearl, resting directly on her skin at her navel.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and large drop earrings, a gold chain ending in a heavy black iron bell on one ear and a silver chain ending in a heavy gold pendant on the other, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height beach huts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
